title: Best weight-projection method by end-to-end accuracy (fast ablation, rollout_batch)
success_criteria: chain runs unattended end-to-end (2 fire-smokes + 3 arms) with no human intervention and no unexplained halt
both fire-smokes pass their signature gates (boot + first anchor fire + correct config echo: window=2 / min_snapshots=4)
all 3 accuracy arms reach step 60 with no NaN; distinctive per-fire signatures present (progressive ladder / checkpoints=2/2 / checkpoints=4/4)
every arm's anchor fires replay the full rollout batch (512 prompts / 4096 seqs)
val@20/40/60 for all three arms (+ step-0 on baseline) captured from on-box train.log; step-60 val backfilled to WandB
verdict.md ranks {current, W2, W4} by val@60 (0.5pt tie bar; tiebreaks val@40, stability, evr/r2) and notes the growing_fixed_base accuracy deferral (mechanism validated by the v1 probe)
hypothesis: Projection fit order materially affects rank-1 RELEX anchor projection quality, measurable end-to-end: best of {current progressive min2/window4, fixed W2 secant, fixed W4 full-fit} decided by MATH val accuracy at step 60 (val@40 corroborates; <0.5pt = tie -> val@40, stability, evr/r2). All at batch_scope=rollout_batch. growing_fixed_base accuracy deferred (byte-identical to sliding until step 50).
